To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
EMBARC is able to adapt a vehicle's transmission rates as a function of vehicle dynamics and congestion conditions to improve the tracking performance of DSRC based collision avoidance systems.
the proposed EMBARC algorithm has the best tracking performance among the algorithms that take into account both channel load and dynamics.

EMBARC is a congestion control algorithm that uses adaptive rate control and preemptive message scheduling based on vehicle dynamics to achieve superior performance in terms of message transmission accuracy compared to existing congestion control algorithms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a congestion control scheme for DSRC that is able to adapt to channel load and vehicle mobility.
the development of an adaptive congestion control algorithm that is able to adapt the transmission rate of safety messages as a function of the channel load and the vehicular dynamics.
developing a congestion control algorithm for vehicle safety applications that takes both vehicle dynamics and channel load into account.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
EMBARC provides better performance compared to other algorithms.
EMBARC outperforms all other algorithms for all scenarios considered.
the EMBARC algorithm is able to achieve the highest tracking performance for the majority of the vehicle densities, and is able to adapt to the channel load in a manner similar to LIMERIC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
EMBARC is able to achieve a good balance between tracking performance and channel congestion.
EMBARC can achieve the best tracking accuracy for vehicles moving at high speeds while also being able to adapt to the channel load.
EMBARC is the first algorithm that takes both channel load and vehcile dynamics into account.
The main takeaway from our work is that
channel load and vehicle motion are complementary factors that should both be taken into account when designing congestion control algorithms.
the proposed EMBARC algorithm provides the best tracking performance in a large range of vehicle density, while maintaining the channel load within an acceptable range.
the combination of adaptive rate control and preemptive scheduling is an effective means of reducing tracking errors.
